name: Importing
when: Bringing in a CSV, Parquet file or spreadsheet

variants.name: Gulp cards
variants.desc: Cards slide in from the left and get gulped down.

variants.name: Vacuum
variants.desc: Bits of data get sucked in from both sides.

variants.name: Funnel
variants.desc: Data pours through a funnel straight into its head.

variants.name: Unpack
variants.desc: Items pop out of a box and fly into its head.

variants.name: File in
variants.desc: A file slides in, gets a once-over, then disappears inside.
